name: Brass Squire, Felidar Umbra — "attach target Equipment you control to target creature" and "Attach this Aura to target creature" attach once picked
notes: Memory: project_fired_attach_to_target_2026-11-18. Brass Squire's ability gets a picker per target (slot 1 the Equipment you control, slot 2 the creature you control); once both are picked Bonesplitter is attached to Grizzly Bears (+2/+0). The opponent's Short Sword is not in slot 1. Felidar Umbra, on Runeclaw Bear, is moved to Grizzly Bears by its own activated ability: Runeclaw Bear loses lifelink. Bloodthirsty Blade has no Equip line; its own picker lists what its "{1}: Attach this Equipment to target creature an opponent controls" allows (Gray Ogre), and keeps Savannah Lions, yours, which Brass Squire attached it to.
